workWhat You Bring* Master’s degree or equivalent in business administration, engineering, economics or another relevant discipline* Several years of experience in project management, PMO or jobs.occupation: Principal Scientist | Target Discovery - Liver Diseases (m/f/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionLiver cirrhosis and its complications have few effective treatment options. Join us and help find the next generation of therapeutic targets. As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and work alongside talented colleagues. You will combine human patient data with functional genomics in disease-relevant cellular models. Apply now and seize the opportunity within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is part time eligible with 80%.Tasks & responsibilities- Manage an in vitro pharmacology laboratory and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists.- Lead target identification and validation projects in liver cirrhosis, from human genetic or multi-omics hypotheses to functional proof of concept.- Design and run functional genomics strategies, including CRISPR-based (KO, CRISPRi/a), low-throughput, high-content perturbation screens in disease-relevant models.- Develop and qualify advanced in vitro and ex vivo models of liver disease.- Work with computational biology teams to analyze screening data.- Build collaborations with academic partners and external alliances.- Represent target projects in cross-functional teams and governance meetingsRequirements- Doctorate (PhD) in biology, biochemistry, or molecular pharmacology, with 5+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech industries.- Strong background in liver jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day To support the extended responsibilities of the Sales Guidance & Enablement team within Siemens Energy Grid Technologies, there is an immediate business need for a Partner Enablement Manager (f/m/d) in Germany. This role is crucial in driving structured sales guidance and enablement strategies for our global network of partners, including agents and distributors, to accelerate market reach and align with strategic growth objectives.
